### Meaning
| infl. | class  | meaning                                               |
| ----- | ------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| ~     | *n.*   | entry, insertion, input                               |
| ~en   | *v.*   | to enter, insert, put in, contain, include, fill with |
| ~a    | *psv.* | entered, input, inserted, contained, included         |
### Implied meaning
- filling a container
### Etymology
#### Glyph
[[Sen'fi/Glossary/Spatial concepts/in\|in]] with an object. Vaguely resembles 入.

- Related to [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Spatial concepts/in\|in]]
